players.product: Power-first greenfield AI data-center campuses on 15-year triple-net leases (River Bend LA for Anthropic; Beacon Point TX) - ex-Bitcoin-mining platform (American Bitcoin affiliate)

quarterly_data.signal: Hut 8's 10-K names the counterparties supporting the initial phase of the River Bend partnership: Entergy will be providing power to the site, Vertiv is the power provider for the site, and Jacobs is serving as general contractor.

connects_to.relationship: River Bend (LA) campus lease party holding a right of first offer on expansion capacity

contracts.signal: Hut 8's 10-K: the 15-year triple-net River Bend lease with Fluidstack has a base contract value of approximately $7.0 billion, with the potential to increase to $17.7 billion through renewal options; the initial data hall is scheduled for completion and commissioning in Q2 2027, with additional data halls scheduled to come online over the balance of 2027.
contracts.value: approximately $7.0 billion base contract value; potential $17.7 billion through renewal options

connects_to.relationship: River Bend (Louisiana) greenfield AI data-center campus built and leased to Anthropic on a 15-year triple-net lease; tenant holds a right of first offer on the next gigawatt

contracts.signal: Hut 8's 10-K: as part of the partnership, Hut 8 and Anthropic may jointly diligence and develop up to 1,050 MW of additional optional capacity across Hut 8's broader pipeline, for a total of up to 2,295 MW of AI data center infrastructure.
contracts.units: up to 1,050 MW of additional optional capacity; total up to 2,295 MW
